French Far-Right Party Expels Member Over Racist Remarks

France's far-right Rassemblement National (RN) party has expelled a police officer who was a member, after footage emerged of him making racist remarks with colleagues while on duty. The incident, with footage released on Tuesday, occurred as the party, led by Marine Le Pen, seeks to improve its public image ahead of next year's presidential elections. The police officer is now under investigation.
